233-tracking-backend-api.reason: Issue #233 PR2 adds six shared backend items: fetched Choice, View, Plan, read, execute and the operation marker. They bind fetched full refs to revalidated local tracking changes and exact undo. No new domain dependency is introduced.
233-tracking-backend-api.remediation: Consolidate the marker and execution adapter into one backend entrypoint when operation envelopes are typed; keep metadata helpers private.

233-tracking-dialog-api.reason: Issue #233 PR2 exposes one owned upstream picker Form to the existing Dialog coordinator. Picker state and asynchronous snapshots stay in the tracking feature.
233-tracking-dialog-api.remediation: Keep state private and reduce this export when Dialog composition becomes feature-owned.

233-tracking-dispatch.reason: Issue #233 PR2 adds three coordinator references for the existing operation pipeline to dispatch the tracking marker and for Dialog to hold the owned Form. The picker uses existing domain dependencies.
233-tracking-dispatch.remediation: Consolidate tracking marker dispatch behind a typed operation boundary and keep all picker logic in its owning feature.
